name: txext-probe
description: Probes how a Polkadot host builds create_transaction for each txExtVersion, and logs every step

scripts.deploy:paseo: DOMAIN=${DOMAIN:?set DOMAIN, e.g. DOMAIN=txextprobe.paseo} sh -c 'VITE_PRODUCT_DOTNS=$DOMAIN npm run build && npx -y ${BULLETIN_DEPLOY_SPEC:-bulletin-deploy@latest} --env paseo-next-v2 --no-transfer-to-signedin-user ./dist $DOMAIN'
